#454

- Growing in shelves on fallen Bitternut Hickory log in mixed oak/hickory woodland.
- Caps reddish-brown, radially zonate, pileipellis consisting of dense matted down hairs radiating outward from base.
- Hymenium buff colored irregular shaped pores.
- Stipe absent.

Additional Details
- Spore Print: Orange
